name: server-expressions
description: Server expressions, the filters, rules and server calculations evaluated as SQL, are checked when saved (2026-11-24, 26.12.01). A filter that names a question the bundle does not have, compares text with a number, or is not true or false is refused with a message that says why, for notifications and case alerts; a console filter gets the same readable message. A filter saved while its question exists and then broken by deleting the question is kept: the survey change warns about it (the MCP edit reply says so), the operational issues report lists it, the notification can still be saved unchanged, and changing it to another broken filter is refused. Keeps its survey, one record (so its results table exists: a console filter on a survey with no table returns nothing before it is checked, and a deleted question's kept column must not count as a meta column, fixed 2026-11-24) and one notification, which sends to the se_name question, whose answers are not addresses, and whose filter the record fails, so nothing is sent.
